sys_hub_action_type_definition.annotation: Create a Document Intelligence task. Provide the use case for the task, the source record from which to create the task (if applicable) and the attachments to include in the task.
sys_hub_action_type_definition.description:
Create a Document Intelligence task. This action creates a new document task but does not automatically send it for processing.
Inputs:
Display Name: how you would like the document task to be named
Use Case: the use case associated with the document task
Source Table Name (optional): the source table that contains the source record
Source Record ID (optional): the source record from which to create the document task
Attachment IDs (optional): the attachments to include in the document task (if this parameter is left blank, all attachments associated with the source record will be included)
Output:
Task ID: a reference to the document task created
sys_hub_action_type_definition.name: CCH - Create a Document Task
